Domain-limited search (congress.gov, govinfo.gov) found H.R. 8625, USTDA Modernization Act of 2026, introduced 2026-04-30 (sponsor Del. Moylan, original cosponsor Rep. One standard news search (USTDA future, abolish, 2026) returned only CRS products on the agency (2026-01-30 and 2026-07-13 versions of IF10673) and trade-policy commentary; no report of an elimination proposal.

status_summary: A CRS In Focus product updated 2026-07-13 states that the second-term Administration did not propose to cut or abolish the agency, that Congress appropriated $87 million for FY2026 in P.L. 119-75 (the same level as FY2023 to FY2025), and that $77 million was requested for FY2027. It reports no staffing cuts or wind-down; the only executive order it mentions, Executive Order 14285, gave the agency a role in a seabed minerals report.
